name: euricom-plugins-directory
description: Directory of popular Claude Code extensions including development tools, productivity plugins, and MCP integrations

plugins.name: example-plugin
plugins.description: A comprehensive example plugin demonstrating all Claude Code extension options including commands, agents, skills, hooks, and MCP servers

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Browser automation and end-to-end testing MCP server by Microsoft. Enables Claude to interact with web pages, take screenshots, fill forms, click elements, and perform automated browser testing workflows.

plugins.name: euricom-word-template
plugins.description: Produce professional .docx documents in the Euricom brand template (Aptos fonts, brand colours, logo, cover, TOC, branded notes/quotes/tables).

plugins.name: euricom-powerpoint-template
plugins.description: Produce professional .pptx presentations in the Euricom brand template (Montserrat, brand colours, dark cover/section slides, content slides, quote slide, automatic page numbers).

plugins.name: accessibility-testing
plugins.description: Diagnose and test web accessibility across the full stack — browser accessibility tree, platform accessibility APIs (UIA, IAccessible2, AX API), and screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, Narrator). Includes testing matrix, ARIA guidance, and debugging workflow. Based on the JSNation 2026 talk by Tshepiso Lehutjo.

plugins.name: claude-marketplace-builder
plugins.description: Scaffold a new Claude Code plugin marketplace or extend an existing one — generates marketplace.json, plugin.json, and the directory layout the platform expects.
